contribution: An explicit continuous fixed-genus limit, its uniform CDF bound and second moment for the normalized pivot-gap run. The finite remainder data and leading first moment are prior coverage or immediate consequences.
scientific_limitations: Uniform sampling of reflective numerical semigroups at fixed genus. The gap run contains the integer g and need not be the longest. The bound is not claimed optimal. Finite checks do not establish the limit or bibliographic priority.
title: A harmonic-step limit law for the genus-pivot gap in reflective numerical semigroups
